verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents a dedicated streaming ingestion API: the Storage Write API (gRPC) streams data into tables with exactly-once delivery semantics. Pub/Sub BigQuery subscriptions are documented for real-time streaming that loads data as it is generated, and the docs describe near-real-time analytics over incoming data. Missing for 10: an explicit documented claim of seconds-level time-to-queryable latency (only implied by 'real-time'/'near real time' wording), and independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming freshness.
